title: Prove the attained causal single-delivery rank floor for every original BIT arrival
body:
Every original paid arrival of the current PR7001 BIT word already has minimum rank among single nested transfers from its original causal chart libraries, in either orientation. The model grants free retained banks and scalar XOR formation, while keeping the required row, destination, deadline and all independent inputs. **No new kappa is claimed.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/PROOF.md), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/RESULT.json), [full certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/CERTIFICATE.json.gz), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/a4fd22c08058c0fef830306b2d46e4a51f091939/research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction/CREDITS.md). The [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19714806) defines the changed paid-path contract and bounded test.

All 51,156 ordered nested-or-identical chart pairs are checked by integer row reduction and a separate complement-pairing calculation. There are no distinct equal-frame charts. Every cheaper donor option has an explicit binary dual that annihilates its strictly earlier library and pairs to one with the required arrival.

| Orientation | Original arrivals | Cheaper cases | Exact library pairings |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Forward | 2,871 | 38,580 | 291,838 |
| Transpose | 2,871 | 31,777 | 205,844 |

The **70,357** cases include **64,615 cheaper positive-rank deliveries** and 5,742 zero-rank destination controls. All 497,682 library pairings vanish and all required-arrival pairings equal one. The largest library has 545 rows; the largest dual support is 72. All 5,742 original source deliveries are independently confirmed to remain available at the original rank, so the bound is attained in this model.

Every positive power tariff increases with rank. Therefore the compatible paid saving is exactly zero, with productive targets unchanged. The complete caller still charges 36 native invocations, 107352 paid calls, 19950 targets and rank surplus 1506, including all query, idle and root terms. The conclusion applies to `0<=kappa<1`; it needs no new root approximation or historical caller ceiling. The selected saving `.00363005817` remains unchanged.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The source replay and exact inputs of [PR #7720](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7720), head `3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef`, are retained unchanged. Its [source checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3e56de8c160f259612f9766e06bf6990c7b5a3ef/research/bit-single-relation-bank-obstruction/verify.py) is rerun; its helper-relation theorem is separate from this result. The original native comes from [PR #7001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7001), SHA-256 `51203e7fc75ba10bd3ac3f8e675759f47e13d262bea66b6600d1e515095cad78`. All 19 retained source/license files have exact byte pins.

The [fixed-destination proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b28b6bb7e0153c4c252b7e907ec0d501edfbe069/research/bit-destination-span-bound/PROOF.md) in [PR #7293](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7293) uses already-live destination rows and explicitly excludes changed paid deliveries. Its zero-rank scope is credited overlap. [PR #7200](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7200) and [PR #7306](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7306) concern 35 adjusted deliveries of an eight-port retag. This result covers every original arrival and all cheaper nested charts. [PR #7722](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7722) instead changes helper promises with fixed paid paths.

Use CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-causal-delivery-rank-obstruction
```

Each registered command prints the retained source result, then:

```text
PASS_CAUSAL_BIT_DELIVERY_RANK_FLOOR 70357 497682 zero replacements
```

Normal and optimized replay pass. The separate set-based source interpretation checks every new dual by direct pairing. Six changed certificates fail, including use of an arrival at its own deadline. All original-source attainments, retained native/frame/invoice checks, exact bytes, committed modes/history, package export, sealed read-only Git-free replay, public links and rendered publication readback pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44367927660/job/135026576200) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The theorem excludes only a single nested delivery from the original causal library. New charts, changed values/deadlines, multiple paid routes, matrix-valued coefficients, helper promises and adaptive library changes remain outside scope. Physical caller, native phases, owned storage, compiler, tape and analytic interfaces remain inherited, with all five framework assumptions. Full predecessor suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. This is source-aware author checking, not blind, independent human or formal acceptance. No selected-frontier or other workstream change is included.

Credit Jerry Chen / @CubeJerry for PR7001, zxv and retained authors for the native, DreamingOfClouds for the caller, ToikY for the fixed-destination and retag exclusions, Ali Romman for the retained-bank source checks, and Cinna Davis and retained framework contributors. All original notices remain. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
